Notes on the Drevalish

Touching: a selvoric arc, a quendral line, a braskovan word, the cor2vel mark and a telvo, with its comma.

Tight code: call vintoresk and (mardel).

Padded code: call skolimber and (parvesh).

Icons: seeHoldren once, then Grevik, twice, and halTamsel last.

So tormelask claimed.

Later

End of the notes.
